nusmp.skill.shishou.description: Ultimate. The talking sword's abilities as one skill: switch modes (Telekinesis, Sensory, Defence, Offence, Storage, Magic, Counsel) with the mode key, press the skill key to use the mode, sneak and press to pick the next ability of a mode. Hold him in your hand to cast; his own mana pays.
shishou.skill_msg.granted: Shishou answers: the Ultimate skill Shishou is yours.
shishou.skill_msg.revoked: Shishou is no longer yours: the skill fades.
shishou.msg.counsel: Shishou, level %s (%s%% to the next), mana %s / %s, %s skills eaten.
shishou.msg.mode_locked: Nothing in %s is open to me yet.
shishou.tooltip.feed: Click a stack of monster drops or magic stones on me in your inventory to feed me.
shishou.feed.own_inventory: Feed me from your own inventory.
shishou.feed.valuable: That is too precious to eat.
shishou.feed.off: Feeding is switched off on this server.
shishou.feed.full: I can grow no more. Keep it.
